column4: new question
column7: The Ministry for the Interior is taking the lead in implementing the HVD regulation. Data providers are meeting regularly to discuss progress and remaining issues. Most of the data concerned was already open in the Netherlands and available through national level services. All providers did an inventory and impact assessment. There is still uncertainty wrt the scope of the environmental data. Wrt company register there has been uncertainty wrt the inclusion of personal data. There is a national level register (aanmerkingsregister.nl) that indicates which agency is responsible for HVD sources. The national open data portal is yet to add a HVD category to it, which is dependent also on a few outstanding metadata issues over all HVD themes.

column2: 1.2 Governance of open data

Is there a governance structure in place that enables the participation and/or inclusion of various open data stakeholders? 

For Explanation:
*  If yes, please briefly describe the governance structure and its operating model
column4: new question
column7: On the national level, the Ministry of the Interior is responsible for open data policies and practices, but they work together with all the departments, implementing organisations, provinces, municipalities, and the water boards. For example on the creation of the national data strategy (IBDS) and its implementation, the governance structure has been described here on page 25: https://realisatieibds.nl/file/download/1c9729a6-70a9-4bda-a245-49c1d6d63adb/meerjarenaanpak-interbestuurlijke-datastrategie6maart2023.pdf ; there is OBDO: Overheidsbreed Beleidsoverleg Digitale Overheid 'intergovernmental policy committee for digital administration. OBDO is an advisory board for digital policy and ICT use within the public sector, with representatives from all layers of government. And IDO: Interbestuurlijk Data Overleg, intergovernmental data committee, mandated by OBDO to determine the strategy for government data policy and (inter)governmental data related programs (such as IBDS, the intergovernmental data strategy), for which it sets the scope and direction. And there is a focusgroup working on the implementation.

column2: 1.3 Open data implementation

Do data publication plans exist at public body level?

For Explanation:
* If yes, please provide the URL and briefly highlight the key aspects covered.
column4: There are standard publication plans on national and local level provided by the National dataportal and biggest cities. These plans also implement the DCAT standardized value list for mandatory fields to fill during publication. There is in addition a staged publication process. The biggest data owning organization first publish data in internal catalogues, before it is published in the public and national datapportals.
